description: CRC-10/ATM vectors for RecoveryCode protected fields. catalogCheckValue below reproduces the well-known external CRC-10/ATM catalog check value, as its own nested description states. The remaining `vectors` entries (empty, asciiA, asciiHelloWorld, and the two recoveryCode* fixtures) are project-normative: repository-chosen inputs run through that same officially parametrised CRC-10/ATM algorithm, not independently published values.

catalogCheckValue.description: The well-known CRC-10/ATM catalog check value: CRC-10/ATM of the ASCII bytes of "123456789", MSB-first byte by byte, published independently of this module or its spec.
